panels.title: Latest QSTS result per criterion and series
panels.description: zero_tolerance / prodist_m8_zero_tolerance: first violating step. prodist_m8_drp_drc: weekly DRP <= 3 %, DRC <= 0.5 % over 10-min readings with PV attribution. week_p10/p50: spread of the weekly capacities.

targets.rawSql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_value->>'criterion',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'))
         network, run_timestamp, raw_value
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method = 'qsts' AND network = '$network' AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY raw_value->>'criterion',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT raw_value->>'criterion' AS criterion, round((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric, 3) AS lambda_max, round((raw_value->>'total_pv_mw')::numeric, 3) AS total_pv_mw, raw_value->>'binding_constraint' AS binding_constraint, coalesce(raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic') AS series, round((raw_value->'window_lambda_quantiles'->>'p10')::numeric, 3) AS week_p10, round((raw_value->'window_lambda_quantiles'->>'p50')::numeric, 3) AS week_p50, raw_value->>'baseline_lower_compliant' AS baseline_lower_ok, run_timestamp FROM q ORDER BY series, criterion

panels.title: Effect of the duration criterion (per series)
panels.description: duration_gain_pct: how much the PRODIST weekly allowance raises the capacity over the zero-tolerance QSTS on the same series. Expect >= 0 (tested invariant).

targets.rawSql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_value->>'criterion',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'))
         network, run_timestamp, raw_value
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method = 'qsts' AND network = '$network' AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY raw_value->>'criterion',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT coalesce(raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic') AS series, round(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE raw_value->>'criterion' IN ('zero_tolerance', 'prodist_m8_zero_tolerance')), 3) AS tau_zero, round(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE raw_value->>'criterion' = 'prodist_m8_drp_drc'), 3) AS prodist_drp_drc, round(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE raw_value->>'criterion' = 'en50160_weekly'), 3) AS en50160_weekly, round(100 * (max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE raw_value->>'criterion' = 'prodist_m8_drp_drc') / nullif(max((raw_value->>'lambda_max')::numeric) FILTER (WHERE raw_value->>'criterion' IN ('zero_tolerance', 'prodist_m8_zero_tolerance')), 0) - 1), 1) AS duration_gain_pct FROM q GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Verification at the capacity (critical week, worst bus)
panels.description: Exact per-bus recount at the reported capacity. PRODIST allows DRP 3 % and DRC 0.5 %.

targets.rawSql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_value->>'criterion',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'))
         network, run_timestamp, raw_value
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method = 'qsts' AND network = '$network' AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY raw_value->>'criterion',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT raw_value->>'criterion' AS criterion, raw_value->>'critical_window' AS critical_week, round(100 * (raw_value->'verification'->>'worst_bus_upper_drp')::numeric, 2) AS worst_bus_drp_pct, round(100 * (raw_value->'verification'->>'worst_bus_upper_drc')::numeric, 2) AS worst_bus_drc_pct, raw_value->'verification'->>'within_regulatory_allowance_per_bus' AS within_allowance FROM q WHERE raw_value ? 'verification' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly capacities
panels.description: One bar per week and criterion. The annual capacity is the minimum over weeks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (raw_value->>'criterion',
                      coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'))
         network, run_timestamp, raw_value
  FROM bronze.hosting_capacity_results
  WHERE method = 'qsts' AND network = '$network' AND raw_value->>'status' = 'ok'
  ORDER BY raw_value->>'criterion',
           coalesce(raw_value->>'series_manifest_sha256', raw_value->>'series_source', 'synthetic'),
           run_timestamp DESC
) SELECT 'week ' || lpad(w->>'index', 2, '0') AS week, raw_value->>'criterion' AS criterion, (w->>'lambda_max')::float AS lambda_max FROM q, jsonb_array_elements(q.raw_value->'windows') AS w WHERE w->>'lambda_max' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1, 2
